title: Model Optimization
question: Can the 5,000 training records be split into five folds that keep the class distribution, put each record in exactly one fold, and repeat exactly with the same seed?

setup.method: group by RiskLevel (ordinal order), Fisher-Yates shuffle of each group with one seeded Random, round-robin assignment with the fold counter carried across groups
setup.testSetUse: test-1000.csv is read only for the train/test overlap check; it takes no part in the split or in model selection

notes: Each class differs by at most one record between folds, and every fold holds exactly 1,000 records.
Each validation fold holds 44-45 High-risk records, against 8-9 per fold with the original 300-row dataset.
GetFoldSplit(folds, k) returns the four training folds and validation fold k for each cross-validation run.
